mcp.compact_instructions: Use memory_search, then memory_read, or use memory_execute with saved references like $hits.results.0.path. For staged ZIP uploads, read memory://workflow/asset_pack and memory://catalog/propose before submitting an attach_asset_pack change. Do not use scripts or hand-built/raw MCP protocol calls to work around interaction gaps; use supported MCP tools and documented upload workflows, and file a GitHub issue at https://github.com/rcarmo/memento/issues when an interaction mode is missing. If enabled, memory_route can classify one shallow read request into a deterministic action.

tools.name: memory_execute

execute_only_operations.description: List visible concepts under a path prefix.
Compare a bounded caller-provided manifest with an authorised namespace inventory.
Inspect bounded asset version metadata and concept-body parity without returning ZIPs or concept bodies.
Inspect graph neighbors and backlinks for a concept.
Audit authorised repository content and bounded graph diagnostics with deterministic repair guidance.
Produce a bounded answer with exact citations when enabled.
Create a deterministic proposal from explicit changes.
Draft a proposal from freeform content when model proposals are enabled.
Draft a proposal update from an instruction when model proposals are enabled.
Read a bounded proposal summary or the detailed proposal record with per-change conflict metadata.
List bounded, cursor-paginated summaries of visible proposal records.
Rebase a clean proposal in place, retaining author and assets; original author or scoped curator, durable key required.
Create a follow-up proposal from a conflict-free subset of a stale proposal.
Reconcile an owned operation; proposers may reconcile their own rebases, curators their own mutations.
Review a proposal as curator.
Apply an approved proposal through the Git transaction pipeline.
Create a concept directly as curator.
Patch a concept directly as curator.
Move a concept to /trash/ retaining original permissions and assets.
Restore a trashed concept to its original path; reject collisions.
Permanently delete a trashed concept and accepted assets from current state; requires confirm=true and retains Git history.
Rename a concept directly as curator.

operations.description: Discover Memento workflows, resources, and execution guidance.
Read service readiness, repository revision, and configured limits.
Search visible concepts by lexical or semantic query.
Read one visible concept by path or concept id.
Read a bounded namespace inventory with stable body digests and asset metadata, without concept bodies.
Classify one shallow read request through the optional Needle router and dispatch deterministically.
Create a one-time raw ZIP upload ticket for a staged asset pack.
Reconcile a staged asset upload ticket and retrieve its staged_asset_id.

Read an accepted asset: view=manifest omits ZIP bytes; view=file requires file_path; view=archive supports bounded offset/limit. Small archives remain inline by default. Resume with the resolved version and expected_sha256. Limits: memory_status.limits.assets.
Execute a bounded declarative multi-step memory plan.

asset_pack.profile: Use one authenticated principal with reader, proposer, and curator roles plus write access to every affected path.

staging_fallback.when: Use only when the MCP request would exceed the configured ceiling or the client deliberately uses raw binary HTTP upload.

steps.result: For a skill, use canonical UTF-8/LF text with no trailing whitespace or final newline, then make the concept body and ZIP-root SKILL.md byte-identical. Base64-encode the ZIP.

arguments.rationale: Attach the reviewed skill pack to its concept.

steps.result: Use zip_base64 when the complete MCP request fits the configured request ceiling.

Approve with the same authenticated curator profile after the manifest, staged files, and concept diff match the intended pack.
Apply with the current expected revision and a durable idempotency key.
If the commit response is interrupted, reconcile the returned operation id under the same principal before retrying.
Retrieve the accepted version and verify its manifest, SHA-256, and decoded ZIP bytes.

mcp.compact_instructions: Use memory_search, then memory_read, or use memory_execute with saved references like $hits.results.0.path. For staged ZIP uploads, read memory://workflow/asset_pack and memory://catalog/propose before submitting an attach_asset_pack change. Do not use scripts or hand-built/raw MCP protocol calls to work around interaction gaps; use supported MCP tools and documented upload workflows, and file a GitHub issue at https://github.com/rcarmo/memento/issues when an interaction mode is missing. If enabled, memory_route can classify one shallow read request into a deterministic action.

asset_pack.profile: Use one authenticated principal with reader, proposer, and curator roles plus write access to every affected path.

steps.result: For a skill, use canonical UTF-8/LF text with no trailing whitespace or final newline, then make the concept body and ZIP-root SKILL.md byte-identical. Base64-encode the ZIP.

arguments.rationale: Attach the reviewed skill pack to its concept.

Approve with the same authenticated curator profile after the manifest, staged files, and concept diff match the intended pack.
Apply with the current expected revision and a durable idempotency key.
If the commit response is interrupted, reconcile the returned operation id under the same principal before retrying.
Retrieve the accepted version and verify its manifest, SHA-256, and decoded ZIP bytes.

mcp.compact_instructions: Use memory_search, then memory_read, or use memory_execute with saved references like $hits.results.0.path. For staged ZIP uploads, read memory://workflow/asset_pack and memory://catalog/propose before submitting an attach_asset_pack change. Do not use scripts or hand-built/raw MCP protocol calls to work around interaction gaps; use supported MCP tools and documented upload workflows, and file a GitHub issue at https://github.com/rcarmo/memento/issues when an interaction mode is missing. If enabled, memory_route can classify one shallow read request into a deterministic action.

mcp.compact_instructions: Use memory_search, then memory_read, or use memory_execute with saved references like $hits.results.0.path. For staged ZIP uploads, read memory://workflow/asset_pack and memory://catalog/propose before submitting an attach_asset_pack change. Do not use scripts or hand-built/raw MCP protocol calls to work around interaction gaps; use supported MCP tools and documented upload workflows, and file a GitHub issue at https://github.com/rcarmo/memento/issues when an interaction mode is missing. If enabled, memory_route can classify one shallow read request into a deterministic action.

mcp.compact_instructions: Use memory_search, then memory_read, or use memory_execute with saved references like $hits.results.0.path. For staged ZIP uploads, read memory://workflow/asset_pack and memory://catalog/propose before submitting an attach_asset_pack change. Do not use scripts or hand-built/raw MCP protocol calls to work around interaction gaps; use supported MCP tools and documented upload workflows, and file a GitHub issue at https://github.com/rcarmo/memento/issues when an interaction mode is missing. If enabled, memory_route can classify one shallow read request into a deterministic action.

tools.name: memory_execute

execute_only_operations.description: List visible concepts under a path prefix.
Compare a bounded caller-provided manifest with an authorised namespace inventory.
Inspect bounded asset version metadata and concept-body parity without returning ZIPs or concept bodies.
Inspect graph neighbors and backlinks for a concept.
Create a deterministic proposal from explicit changes.
Draft a proposal from freeform content when model proposals are enabled.
Draft a proposal update from an instruction when model proposals are enabled.
Rebase a clean proposal in place, retaining author and assets; original author or scoped curator, durable key required.
Create a concept directly as curator.
Patch a concept directly as curator.
Rename a concept directly as curator.

operations.description: Discover Memento workflows, resources, and execution guidance.
Read service readiness, repository revision, and configured limits.
Search visible concepts by lexical or semantic query.
Read one visible concept by path or concept id.
Read a bounded namespace inventory with stable body digests and asset metadata, without concept bodies.
Audit authorised repository content and bounded graph diagnostics with deterministic repair guidance.
Produce a bounded answer with exact citations when enabled.
Read a bounded proposal summary or the detailed proposal record with per-change conflict metadata.
List bounded, cursor-paginated summaries of visible proposal records.
Inspect staged proposal asset metadata or one bounded manifest-listed file.
Create a follow-up proposal from a conflict-free subset of a stale proposal.
Reconcile an owned operation; proposers may reconcile their own rebases, curators their own mutations.
Review a proposal as curator.
Apply an approved proposal through the Git transaction pipeline.
Create a one-time raw ZIP upload ticket for a staged asset pack.
Reconcile a staged asset upload ticket and retrieve its staged_asset_id.

Read an accepted asset: view=manifest omits ZIP bytes; view=file requires file_path; view=archive supports bounded offset/limit. Small archives remain inline by default. Resume with the resolved version and expected_sha256. Limits: memory_status.limits.assets.
Prune retained asset pack versions as curator.
Move a concept to /trash/ retaining original permissions and assets.
Restore a trashed concept to its original path; reject collisions.
Permanently delete a trashed concept and accepted assets from current state; requires confirm=true and retains Git history.
Execute a bounded declarative multi-step memory plan.

asset_pack.profile: Use one authenticated principal with reader, proposer, and curator roles plus write access to every affected path.

staging_fallback.when: Use only when the MCP request would exceed the configured ceiling or the client deliberately uses raw binary HTTP upload.

steps.result: For a skill, use canonical UTF-8/LF text with no trailing whitespace or final newline, then make the concept body and ZIP-root SKILL.md byte-identical. Base64-encode the ZIP.

arguments.rationale: Attach the reviewed skill pack to its concept.

steps.result: Use zip_base64 when the complete MCP request fits the configured request ceiling.
Verify the generated manifest, SHA-256, target path, asset kind, and version before review.
Read any manifest-listed file needed for review through bounded offset/limit retrieval.
Approve with the same authenticated curator profile after the manifest, staged files, and concept diff match the intended pack.
Apply with the current expected revision and a durable idempotency key.
If the commit response is interrupted, reconcile the returned operation id under the same principal before retrying.
Retrieve the accepted version and verify its manifest, SHA-256, and decoded ZIP bytes.

curate.description: List status=unresolved, including needs_rebase and conflicted. Curators may reject/request changes at any base. Original authors or curators can rebase clean proposals in place with an expected revision and durable key, then review again. Reconcile rebase/review/apply through operation_get.

mcp.compact_instructions: Use memory_search, then memory_read, or use memory_execute with saved references like $hits.results.0.path. For staged ZIP uploads, read memory://workflow/asset_pack and memory://catalog/propose before submitting an attach_asset_pack change. Do not use scripts or hand-built/raw MCP protocol calls to work around interaction gaps; use supported MCP tools and documented upload workflows, and file a GitHub issue at https://github.com/rcarmo/memento/issues when an interaction mode is missing. If enabled, memory_route can classify one shallow read request into a deterministic action.

Compare a bounded caller-provided manifest with an authorised namespace inventory.

operations.description: Discover Memento workflows, resources, and execution guidance.

asset_pack.profile: Use one authenticated principal with reader, proposer, and curator roles plus write access to every affected path.

staging_fallback.when: Use only when the MCP request would exceed the configured ceiling or the client deliberately uses raw binary HTTP upload.

steps.result: For a skill, use canonical UTF-8/LF text with no trailing whitespace or final newline, then make the concept body and ZIP-root SKILL.md byte-identical. Base64-encode the ZIP.

arguments.rationale: Attach the reviewed skill pack to its concept.

steps.result: Use zip_base64 when the complete MCP request fits the configured request ceiling.
Verify the generated manifest, SHA-256, target path, asset kind, and version before review.
Read any manifest-listed file needed for review through bounded offset/limit retrieval.
Approve with the same authenticated curator profile after the manifest, staged files, and concept diff match the intended pack.

asset_pack.profile: Use one authenticated principal with reader, proposer, and curator roles plus write access to every affected path.

staging_fallback.when: Use only when the MCP request would exceed the configured ceiling or the client deliberately uses raw binary HTTP upload.

steps.result: For a skill, use canonical UTF-8/LF text with no trailing whitespace or final newline, then make the concept body and ZIP-root SKILL.md byte-identical. Base64-encode the ZIP.

arguments.rationale: Attach the reviewed skill pack to its concept.

steps.result: Use zip_base64 when the complete MCP request fits the configured request ceiling.
Verify the generated manifest, SHA-256, target path, asset kind, and version before review.
Read any manifest-listed file needed for review through bounded offset/limit retrieval.
Approve with the same authenticated curator profile after the manifest, staged files, and concept diff match the intended pack.
Apply with the current expected revision and a durable idempotency key.
If the commit response is interrupted, reconcile the returned operation id under the same principal before retrying.
Retrieve the accepted version and verify its manifest, SHA-256, and decoded ZIP bytes.

curate.description: List status=unresolved, including needs_rebase and conflicted. Curators may reject/request changes at any base. Original authors or curators can rebase clean proposals in place with an expected revision and durable key, then review again. Reconcile rebase/review/apply through operation_get.

mcp.compact_instructions: Use memory_search, then memory_read, or use memory_execute with saved references like $hits.results.0.path. For staged ZIP uploads, read memory://workflow/asset_pack and memory://catalog/propose before submitting an attach_asset_pack change. Do not use scripts or hand-built/raw MCP protocol calls to work around interaction gaps; use supported MCP tools and documented upload workflows, and file a GitHub issue at https://github.com/rcarmo/memento/issues when an interaction mode is missing. If enabled, memory_route can classify one shallow read request into a deterministic action.

tools.name: memory_execute

execute_only_operations.description: Compare a bounded caller-provided manifest with an authorised namespace inventory.
Inspect bounded asset version metadata and concept-body parity without returning ZIPs or concept bodies.
Rebase a clean proposal in place, retaining author and assets; original author or scoped curator, durable key required.

operations.description: Discover Memento workflows, resources, and execution guidance.
Read service readiness, repository revision, and configured limits.
Search visible concepts by lexical or semantic query.
Read one visible concept by path or concept id.
List visible concepts under a path prefix.
Read a bounded namespace inventory with stable body digests and asset metadata, without concept bodies.
Inspect graph neighbors and backlinks for a concept.
Audit authorised repository content and bounded graph diagnostics with deterministic repair guidance.
Produce a bounded answer with exact citations when enabled.
Classify one shallow read request through the optional Needle router and dispatch deterministically.
Create a deterministic proposal from explicit changes.
Draft a proposal from freeform content when model proposals are enabled.
Draft a proposal update from an instruction when model proposals are enabled.
Read a bounded proposal summary or the detailed proposal record with per-change conflict metadata.
List bounded, cursor-paginated summaries of visible proposal records.
Inspect staged proposal asset metadata or one bounded manifest-listed file.
Create a follow-up proposal from a conflict-free subset of a stale proposal.
Reconcile an owned operation; proposers may reconcile their own rebases, curators their own mutations.
Review a proposal as curator.
Apply an approved proposal through the Git transaction pipeline.
Create a one-time raw ZIP upload ticket for a staged asset pack.
Reconcile a staged asset upload ticket and retrieve its staged_asset_id.

Read an accepted asset: view=manifest omits ZIP bytes; view=file requires file_path; view=archive supports bounded offset/limit. Small archives remain inline by default. Resume with the resolved version and expected_sha256. Limits: memory_status.limits.assets.
Prune retained asset pack versions as curator.
Create a concept directly as curator.
Patch a concept directly as curator.
Move a concept to /trash/ retaining original permissions and assets.
Restore a trashed concept to its original path; reject collisions.
Permanently delete a trashed concept and accepted assets from current state; requires confirm=true and retains Git history.
Rename a concept directly as curator.
Execute a bounded declarative multi-step memory plan.

asset_pack.profile: Use one authenticated principal with reader, proposer, and curator roles plus write access to every affected path.

staging_fallback.when: Use only when the MCP request would exceed the configured ceiling or the client deliberately uses raw binary HTTP upload.

steps.result: For a skill, use canonical UTF-8/LF text with no trailing whitespace or final newline, then make the concept body and ZIP-root SKILL.md byte-identical. Base64-encode the ZIP.

arguments.rationale: Attach the reviewed skill pack to its concept.

steps.result: Use zip_base64 when the complete MCP request fits the configured request ceiling.
Verify the generated manifest, SHA-256, target path, asset kind, and version before review.
Read any manifest-listed file needed for review through bounded offset/limit retrieval.
Approve with the same authenticated curator profile after the manifest, staged files, and concept diff match the intended pack.
Apply with the current expected revision and a durable idempotency key.
If the commit response is interrupted, reconcile the returned operation id under the same principal before retrying.
Retrieve the accepted version and verify its manifest, SHA-256, and decoded ZIP bytes.

mcp.compact_instructions: Use memory_search, then memory_read, or use memory_execute with saved references like $hits.results.0.path. For staged ZIP uploads, read memory://workflow/asset_pack and memory://catalog/propose before submitting an attach_asset_pack change. Do not use scripts or hand-built/raw MCP protocol calls to work around interaction gaps; use supported MCP tools and documented upload workflows, and file a GitHub issue at https://github.com/rcarmo/memento/issues when an interaction mode is missing. If enabled, memory_route can classify one shallow read request into a deterministic action.

mcp.compact_instructions: Use memory_search, then memory_read, or use memory_execute with saved references like $hits.results.0.path. For staged ZIP uploads, read memory://workflow/asset_pack and memory://catalog/propose before submitting an attach_asset_pack change. Do not use scripts or hand-built/raw MCP protocol calls to work around interaction gaps; use supported MCP tools and documented upload workflows, and file a GitHub issue at https://github.com/rcarmo/memento/issues when an interaction mode is missing. If enabled, memory_route can classify one shallow read request into a deterministic action.

asset_pack.profile: Use one authenticated principal with reader, proposer, and curator roles plus write access to every affected path.

staging_fallback.when: Use only when the MCP request would exceed the configured ceiling or the client deliberately uses raw binary HTTP upload.

steps.result: For a skill, use canonical UTF-8/LF text with no trailing whitespace or final newline, then make the concept body and ZIP-root SKILL.md byte-identical. Base64-encode the ZIP.

arguments.rationale: Attach the reviewed skill pack to its concept.

steps.result: Use zip_base64 when the complete MCP request fits the configured request ceiling.
Verify the generated manifest, SHA-256, target path, asset kind, and version before review.
Read any manifest-listed file needed for review through bounded offset/limit retrieval.
Approve with the same authenticated curator profile after the manifest, staged files, and concept diff match the intended pack.
Apply with the current expected revision and a durable idempotency key.
If the commit response is interrupted, reconcile the returned operation id under the same principal before retrying.
Retrieve the accepted version and verify its manifest, SHA-256, and decoded ZIP bytes.

mcp.compact_instructions: Use memory_search, then memory_read, or use memory_execute with saved references like $hits.results.0.path. For staged ZIP uploads, read memory://workflow/asset_pack and memory://catalog/propose before submitting an attach_asset_pack change. Do not use scripts or hand-built/raw MCP protocol calls to work around interaction gaps; use supported MCP tools and documented upload workflows, and file a GitHub issue at https://github.com/rcarmo/memento/issues when an interaction mode is missing. If enabled, memory_route can classify one shallow read request into a deterministic action.

tools.name: memory_execute

answer.description: Produce a bounded answer with exact citations when enabled.

asset_get.description: Read an accepted asset: view=manifest omits ZIP bytes; view=file requires file_path; view=archive supports bounded offset/limit. Small archives remain inline by default. Resume with the resolved version and expected_sha256. Limits: memory_status.limits.assets.

asset_metadata.description: Inspect bounded asset version metadata and concept-body parity without returning ZIPs or concept bodies.

asset_prune.description: Prune retained asset pack versions as curator.

asset_stage_begin.description: Create a one-time raw ZIP upload ticket for a staged asset pack.

asset_stage_status.description: Reconcile a staged asset upload ticket and retrieve its staged_asset_id.

audit.description: Audit authorised repository content and bounded graph diagnostics with deterministic repair guidance.

compare_manifest.description: Compare a bounded caller-provided manifest with an authorised namespace inventory.

create.description: Create a concept directly as curator.

execute.description: Execute a bounded declarative multi-step memory plan.

prompt_cases.expected:
Publish and verify a versioned asset pack with one authenticated curator profile.
Target concept: /skills/example.md
Asset kind: skill
Version: 1.0.0
1. Read memory://workflow/asset_pack and memory://catalog/propose.
2. For a skill pack, use canonical UTF-8/LF text with no trailing whitespace or final newline; make the concept body and ZIP-root SKILL.md byte-identical, then base64-encode the ZIP.
3. Submit a propose operation (directly or through memory_execute) using the current repository revision and this change:
{"asset_kind": "skill", "kind": "attach_asset_pack", "path": "/skills/example.md", "version": "1.0.0", "zip_base64": "<base64 ZIP bytes>"}
4. Read the proposal and verify its generated manifest, SHA-256, target path, asset kind, and version.
5. With the same authenticated curator profile, approve and apply using a fresh expected revision and durable idempotency key.
6. Retrieve the accepted version with memory_asset_get and verify the returned manifest, SHA-256, and decoded ZIP bytes.
Use memory_asset_stage_begin, raw HTTP upload, memory_asset_stage_status, and staged_asset_id only when the MCP request would exceed the configured ceiling or the client deliberately uses raw binary HTTP upload.

{"asset_kind": "docs", "kind": "attach_asset_pack", "path": "/skills/caf\u00e9.md", "version": "2.0.0", "zip_base64": "<base64 ZIP bytes>"}
4. Read the proposal and verify its generated manifest, SHA-256, target path, asset kind, and version.

result.description: Build an MCP-native asset publication plan. Categories: assets, proposals

content.text:
Publish and verify a versioned asset pack with one authenticated curator profile.
Target concept: /skills/example.md
Asset kind: skill
Version: 1.0.0
1. Read memory://workflow/asset_pack and memory://catalog/propose.
2. For a skill pack, use canonical UTF-8/LF text with no trailing whitespace or final newline; make the concept body and ZIP-root SKILL.md byte-identical, then base64-encode the ZIP.
3. Submit a propose operation (directly or through memory_execute) using the current repository revision and this change:
{"asset_kind": "skill", "kind": "attach_asset_pack", "path": "/skills/example.md", "version": "1.0.0", "zip_base64": "<base64 ZIP bytes>"}
4. Read the proposal and verify its generated manifest, SHA-256, target path, asset kind, and version.
5. With the same authenticated curator profile, approve and apply using a fresh expected revision and durable idempotency key.
6. Retrieve the accepted version with memory_asset_get and verify the returned manifest, SHA-256, and decoded ZIP bytes.
Use memory_asset_stage_begin, raw HTTP upload, memory_asset_stage_status, and staged_asset_id only when the MCP request would exceed the configured ceiling or the client deliberately uses raw binary HTTP upload.

steps.result: For a skill, use canonical UTF-8/LF text with no trailing whitespace or final newline, then make the concept body and ZIP-root SKILL.md byte-identical. Base64-encode the ZIP.

arguments.rationale: Attach the reviewed skill pack to its concept.

steps.result: Use zip_base64 when the complete MCP request fits the configured request ceiling.
Verify the generated manifest, SHA-256, target path, asset kind, and version before review.
Read any manifest-listed file needed for review through bounded offset/limit retrieval.
Approve with the same authenticated curator profile after the manifest, staged files, and concept diff match the intended pack.
Apply with the current expected revision and a durable idempotency key.
If the commit response is interrupted, reconcile the returned operation id under the same principal before retrying.
Retrieve the accepted version and verify its manifest, SHA-256, and decoded ZIP bytes.

curate.description: List status=unresolved, including needs_rebase and conflicted. Curators may reject/request changes at any base. Original authors or curators can rebase clean proposals in place with an expected revision and durable key, then review again. Reconcile rebase/review/apply through operation_get.

inspect.description: Find relevant concepts, inventory namespaces, then read exact paths when bodies are needed.

propose.description: Search and read context, then submit a proposal instead of writing directly.

trash.description: Prefer propose with kind=trash, inspect archival_impact via proposal_get, then review and apply. Use current revisions and operation_get for retries. Direct trash/restore/purge retain original path permissions and Git history.
